description: List what the cable designer builds, before calling design_cable: presets[] (power, MV, HV, North American, building wire, cords, control, LAN, coaxial, fibre), each with its id, standard, the sentence that builds it in design_cable, its designation (name), voltage, cores, section and metal; and spec_standards[], every family a design_cable spec may name in spec.standard, with its voltages, core counts, sections and metals. Takes only lang. Free, outside the daily free calls, no LLM.

lang.description: The language of the preset sentences and names: any of the site's 15 (en, tr, de, nl, sv, fr, es, da, no, fi, it, ro, pl, cs, ru); default en.

name: design_presets
title: List what the cable designer can build
